command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- os ---'
sed -n '1,8p' /etc/os-release
printf '%s\n' '--- account precheck ---'
if getent passwd inventorysvc; then printf '%s\n' 'ACCOUNT_PRESENT'; else printf '%s\n' 'ACCOUNT_ABSENT'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- home precheck ---'
if [ -e /var/lib/inventory ]; then ls -ldn /var/lib/inventory; else printf '%s\n' 'HOME_ABSENT'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- boot identity baseline ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id

command:
set -eu
test -x /sbin/nologin
useradd --system --create-home --home-dir /var/lib/inventory --shell /sbin/nologin inventorysvc
printf '%s\n' 'inventorysvc created'

set -eu
test -x /sbin/nologin
useradd --system --create-home --home-dir /var/lib/inventory --shell /sbin/nologin inventorysvc
printf '%s\n' 'inventorysvc created'

set -eu
entry=$(getent passwd inventorysvc)
printf 'passwd_entry=[REDACTED] "$entry"
uid=$(id -u inventorysvc)
uid_min=$(awk '$1 == "UID_MIN" { print $2; exit }' /etc/login.defs)
printf 'uid=%s normal_uid_min=%s\n' "$uid" "$uid_min"
test "$uid" -lt "$uid_min"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | awk -F: '{print $6}')" = /var/lib/inventory
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | awk -F: '{print $7}')" = /sbin/nologin
test -d /var/lib/inventory
test "$(stat -c %U /var/lib/inventory)" = inventorysvc
stat -c 'home=%n type=%F owner=%U uid=%u group=%G gid=%g mode=%a' /var/lib/inventory
passwd -S inventorysvc
set +e
login_output=$(su - inventorysvc -c 'printf INTERACTIVE_LOGIN_SUCCEEDED' 2>&1)
login_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'login_attempt_rc=%s output=%s\n' "$login_rc" "$login_output"
test "$login_rc" -ne 0
case "$login_output" in *INTERACTIVE_LOGIN_SUCCEEDED*) exit 1 ;; esac
printf 'boot_id=%s\n' "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)"
printf '%s\n' 'account_health=PASS system_account=PASS home=PASS nologin=PASS'
